Tom Cruise Top 10 Films Ranked

5 July 2023 · RewindZone Archive

Tom Cruise, a renowned actor known for his charisma and versatility, has graced the silver screen with numerous captivating performances. Let's embark on a cinematic journey through some of his most notable films, ranked from lowest to highest based on their Rotten Tomatoes Scores

No. 10

Tropic Thunder (82%) - 2008

Advertisement

In this uproarious and wildly entertaining satirical action comedy, Tom Cruise, a versatile actor known for his impressive range, effortlessly displays his comedic prowess through a truly unforgettable supporting role. With remarkable finesse, Cruise brings to life the character of Les Grossman, a larger-than-life and flamboyant Hollywood executive whose eccentricities and bombastic personality inject a delightful and unexpected twist into the film's already stellar ensemble. Through his impeccable timing, impeccable delivery, and impeccable comedic instincts, Cruise proves once again why he is considered one of the industry's most talented performers, leaving audiences roaring with laughter and craving for more.

No. 9

Magnolia (82%) - 1999

Cruise's extraordinary collaboration with the visionary director Paul Thomas Anderson culminated in the creation of this mesmerizing and enigmatic drama that leaves audiences captivated and contemplative. In a remarkable departure from his typical roles, Cruise fearlessly embraces the character of Frank T.J. Mackey, a complex and multifaceted individual who exudes both charisma and inner turmoil. With an awe-inspiring display of acting prowess, Cruise delves deep into the psyche of Mackey, masterfully navigating the intricacies of his character's journey and bringing forth a performance that is nothing short of mesmerizing. His portrayal is equal parts compelling and thought-provoking, leaving an indelible impression on viewers and solidifying Cruise's status as a versatile and exceptional actor. Through his nuanced portrayal, Cruise invites audiences into the tumultuous world of Mackey, challenging them to question the boundaries of morality, authenticity, and human nature itself.

No.8

Jerry Maguire (84%) - 1996

Advertisement

In this deeply cherished and emotionally resonant romantic comedy-drama, Cruise delivers a tour de force performance as the eponymous protagonist, Jerry Maguire. With unwavering charisma, raw vulnerability, and an unwavering commitment to his craft, Cruise brings forth a portrayal that is nothing short of extraordinary. As the audience immerses themselves in Maguire's gripping tale, Cruise effortlessly captures the essence of his character, breathing life into every scene with a magnetic on-screen presence that is truly captivating. Through his remarkable acting range and impeccable timing, Cruise allows us to witness Maguire's transformative journey—a journey that takes him from the heights of professional success to the depths of personal introspection and ultimately leads him to discover the true meaning of love, integrity, and self-worth. With each nuanced expression and heartfelt gesture, Cruise invites us to empathize with Maguire's crisis of conscience and embark on our own voyage of self-discovery. His portrayal is a testament to his undeniable talent and the indelible mark he leaves on the landscape of cinema, making this beloved film an unforgettable experience for audiences around the world.

No. 7

A Few Good Men (84%) - 1992

In this riveting and compelling courtroom drama, Cruise enthralls and mesmerizes audiences with his portrayal of the resolute and unwavering Lt. Daniel Kaffee. With unwavering determination and an unwavering commitment to justice, Cruise's performance is nothing short of electrifying. As he takes the stage opposite the legendary Jack Nicholson's commanding Colonel Jessup, Cruise's undeniable presence and commanding presence shine through, captivating viewers from start to finish. With each meticulously delivered line and every nuanced gesture, Cruise showcases his exceptional acting prowess and ability to inhabit complex characters with authenticity and depth. His portrayal of Lt. Kaffee not only embodies the unwavering spirit of a military lawyer on a quest for truth, but also highlights Cruise's remarkable ability to capture the essence of a character and breathe life into every moment on screen. It is through his remarkable chemistry and captivating exchanges with Nicholson that the tension and suspense in the courtroom reach new heights, leaving audiences on the edge of their seats. Cruise's performance in this unforgettable film is a true testament to his talent and unwavering dedication to his craft, solidifying his status as one of the most accomplished actors of our time.

No. 6

Collateral (86%) - 2004

In this heart-pounding and exhilarating crime drama, Cruise immerses himself in the role of Vincent, a formidable and calculating hitman who navigates the shadows with chilling precision. With unwavering commitment and remarkable versatility, Cruise breathes life into this morally complex character, delivering a performance that is both mesmerizing and thought-provoking. Through his commanding presence and meticulous attention to detail, he captures the essence of Vincent's enigmatic persona, captivating audiences with each calculated move and piercing gaze. As he shares the screen with the talented Jamie Foxx, who portrays a taxi driver caught in Vincent's deadly web, the chemistry between the two actors is electric, heightening the tension and driving the narrative forward. Cruise's portrayal of Vincent is a masterclass in character exploration, as he delves deep into the psyche of this multifaceted antihero, revealing layers of complexity and vulnerability that make him all the more captivating. With every nuanced performance choice, Cruise showcases his unparalleled range and ability to inhabit even the darkest corners of a character's soul. His portrayal of Vincent in this thrilling crime drama is a testament to his extraordinary talent and unwavering dedication to his craft, leaving an indelible mark on the film and cementing his status as a true cinematic powerhouse.

No. 5

The Color of Money (88%) - 1986

In this captivating and emotionally charged sports drama, Cruise joins forces with the iconic Paul Newman, creating a dynamic duo that electrifies the screen. Together, they breathe new life into the world of pool hustling in this long-awaited sequel to the timeless classic, "The Hustler." Cruise steps into the role of Vincent Lauria, a young and prodigiously talented pool player whose unwavering determination and hunger for success propel him into the fierce and competitive world of high-stakes billiards.

With remarkable skill and undeniable charisma, Cruise holds his own alongside Newman's seasoned and masterful portrayal. The chemistry between these two acting powerhouses is nothing short of extraordinary, as they engage in a mesmerizing game of wits and strategy. Cruise's performance as Vincent Lauria is a tour de force, as he effortlessly captures the character's raw talent, ambition, and unyielding drive. Every shot he takes, every move he makes, exudes a magnetic energy that keeps audiences on the edge of their seats.

In this compelling sports drama, Cruise and Newman's partnership is an unforgettable combination of talent, chemistry, and storytelling prowess. Their on-screen collaboration not only pays homage to the original masterpiece but also adds a new layer of depth and excitement to the narrative. Cruise's portrayal of Vincent Lauria is a shining example of his exceptional acting prowess, solidifying his place among the pantheon of cinematic legends. Together, Cruise and Newman elevate the game of pool into a captivating and emotionally charged experience that will leave audiences enthralled from start to finish.

No. 4

Rain Man (89%) - 1988

In this profoundly moving and emotionally charged drama, Cruise delivers a performance that will resonate deeply with audiences around the world. Paired alongside the incomparable Dustin Hoffman, Cruise takes on the role of Charlie Babbitt, a man whose journey of self-discovery unfolds in the most unexpected way.

Cruise's portrayal of Charlie is nothing short of extraordinary. He effortlessly captures the essence of a self-centered individual, showcasing the flaws, vulnerabilities, and internal conflicts that define the character. With each nuanced expression and subtle gesture, Cruise immerses himself in Charlie's world, allowing the audience to witness the transformation that occurs as he reconnects with his long-lost brother, Raymond, who is brilliantly portrayed by Dustin Hoffman.

Cruise's range as an actor shines through in this touching drama. He seamlessly transitions between moments of tension, heartache, and heartwarming tenderness, capturing the intricacies of the sibling bond with authenticity and grace. His on-screen chemistry with Hoffman is palpable, as they form an unbreakable bond that transcends the boundaries of their individual performances.

Cruise's remarkable performance in this touching drama will leave a lasting impression on viewers. With each scene, Cruise captivates the audience, drawing them into Charlie's world and reminding us of the beauty and transformative power of human connection.

No. 3

Minority Report (90%) - 2002

In this thrilling and thought-provoking sci-fi masterpiece, Cruise once again teams up with the visionary director Steven Spielberg, delivering a performance that will leave audiences on the edge of their seats. As Chief John Anderton, Cruise commands the screen with unwavering intensity and a profound sense of conviction, immersing himself in a world where the boundaries of morality and technology blur.

Cruise's portrayal of Chief John Anderton is incredible. He captures the inner turmoil and conflict that defines the character, navigating the intricate web of moral dilemmas with unwavering commitment. With each calculated step and penetrating gaze, Cruise brings Anderton's journey to life, as he grapples with the consequences of a society governed by predictive crime prevention.

As the film unfolds, Cruise's performance unfolds in parallel, unraveling the layers of Chief Anderton's complex psyche. He effortlessly portrays the weight of his character's responsibilities, balancing the demands of justice, personal loss, and a quest for truth. Cruise's ability to convey the emotional depth and vulnerability of Chief Anderton creates a truly immersive experience for the audience, allowing them to empathize with his struggles and question the very nature of free will and determinism.

With Spielberg's masterful direction and Cruise's exceptional talent, this futuristic sci-fi thriller transcends the boundaries of the genre, becoming a captivating exploration of human nature and the consequences of unchecked technological advancements. Cruise's portrayal of Chief John Anderton serves as the emotional anchor of the film, propelling the narrative forward and leaving a lasting impression on viewers.

No. 2

Edge of Tomorrow (91%) - 2014

In this adrenaline-pumping science fiction extravaganza, Cruise immerses himself in a world of high-stakes action and mind-bending time travel. Portraying a fearless military officer thrust into a relentless time loop amidst an otherworldly invasion, he unleashes a tour de force performance that seamlessly blends his signature charisma with unwavering physical prowess and unyielding resilience.

Cruise effortlessly captures the essence of the character, immersing himself in the tumultuous journey of survival, redemption, and unraveling the mysteries of the time loop. With each electrifying scene, Cruise brings a magnetic energy that propels the film forward, igniting the screen with a perfect balance of charm, intensity, and unwavering determination.

No. 1

Risky Business (92%) - 1983

Securing the prime spot on our roster is Cruise's sensational breakthrough performance as Joel Goodsen, a bright-eyed high school student whose life takes an unexpected twist when his parents embark on a journey away from home. This delightful coming-of-age comedy serves as a captivating showcase for Cruise's innate talent, magnetic charisma, and the boundless star power that would ultimately propel him to the pinnacle of stardom.

With an effortless blend of youthful exuberance and relatable vulnerability, Cruise breathes life into the character, inviting audiences to join him on a wild and unforgettable adventure through the labyrinth of adolescence. From the moment he graces the screen, he captivates with his natural charm and undeniable on-screen presence, leaving an impression that would solidify his status as a rising star.

In this iconic role, Cruise showcases his remarkable range as an actor, seamlessly transitioning between moments of uproarious laughter and heartfelt introspection. His chemistry with the ensemble cast is palpable, breathing life into the dynamic relationships that define the narrative. With each scene, Cruise's magnetic presence illuminates the screen, drawing viewers deeper into Joel Goodsen's whirlwind escapades and making them root for his triumphs and personal growth.

In the annals of cinematic history, Cruise's performance as Joel Goodsen remains an iconic milestone, forever etching his name in the hearts of moviegoers worldwide.

Tom Cruise's filmography is truly remarkable, showcasing his incredible range as an actor and his ability to leave a lasting impression on audiences. Whether he's making us laugh in comedies, stirring our emotions in dramas, thrilling us with action-packed adventures, or capturing our hearts in romantic tales, Cruise has consistently proven himself to be a versatile and enduring talent in the world of Hollywood. His body of work is a testament to his unwavering dedication and the passion he brings to every role he takes on. Cruise's ability to captivate and entertain across various genres is a testament to his immense skill and the joy he brings to his craft. From the big screen to our hearts, he has undoubtedly secured his place as one of the most beloved and iconic actors of our time.
